decisions.decision: Muir will look at expanding browsing hours based on the board's discussion that night.

decisions.decision: Barbara will prepare the strategic plan for the next BOT meeting.

decisions.decision: The vacant staff position will be posted, internally first because it is a union position.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY21 budget was 71% expended in the 11th month of the fiscal year, with large expenses still to come.
budget_items.quote: for the fy21 budget we are in the 11th month of the fiscal year, near the end. the budget is 71% expended.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Library materials and programs were at small percentages expended, and the director said they would be spent before year end.
budget_items.quote: library materials and programs will be expended even though they are currently at small percentages: 41% and 22% respectively.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY22 budget approved at annual town meeting, stated as the amount it will be.
budget_items.quote: the fy22 budget was approved at annual town meeting. it will be $439,541.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The contract services line received a one-time increase to be used for the strategic plan.
budget_items.quote: the contract services budget line item received a one time $3000 increase to be used for the strategic plan.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A trustee asked whether mileage reimbursement could be rolled into other budget items; the director said that would need Town Manager approval. No amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: kate asked about the mileage reimbursement - can it be rolled into other budget items if needed.
